Description
Perched high on the hill in sought-after Dunbar, this well-appointed home captures sweeping city, mountain and water views. Freshly painted, it offers 1,700 sq.ft. of living space across two levels, featuring four bedrooms, two full bathrooms, hardwood flooring and generously sized principal rooms. Multiple patios create inviting spaces for relaxing and entertaining, complemented by ample storage and a two-car garage. Enjoy a welcoming Westside neighbourhood within walking distance of Carnarvon Elementary and Carnarvon Park, with Dunbar Village’s shops, cafés and restaurants nearby. Convenient access to St. George’s School, Dunbar Community Centre, Pacific Spirit Regional Park and UBC further enhances this desirable location. Book your private showing today!
